query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chemical_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_class,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chemical_class IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_class
FROM molecules;
